name: codex-usage-monitor
description: A lightweight Windows desktop monitor for Codex rate-limit usage and reset times.

interface.shortDescription: Monitor Codex usage and reset times on Windows.
interface.longDescription: Start, stop, inspect, and configure the lightweight Codex Usage Monitor desktop companion. It reads rate-limit data through the locally installed, signed-in Codex Desktop app and does not require an API key.
defaultPrompt: 启动 Codex Usage Monitor，并报告运行状态。
检查 Codex Usage Monitor 是否已设置为开机启动。
